description:
Inspect what a package depends on, directly or transitively. Lists direct runtime dependencies with resolved versions; non-runtime groups are omitted by default. Expand transitive footprint, provenance, or issue analysis only when needed, with the corresponding fields; full-graph analysis is not local application lockfile or reachability evidence. Supports npm, pypi, hex, crates, nuget, maven, zig, vcpkg, packagist, rubygems, go, swift, pub.

Load the GitHits guide once per session first (`quick_start` or the `githits-mcp` skill).

format.description: Omit for text. Use json only when code consumes raw fields or text lacks a required field. JSON includes complete issue rows.

include_importers.description: Add importers (upstream package, its resolved version, declared constraint) to each transitive.packages[] entry. Default false; can quadruple large graphs. Requests the full transitive block unless max_depth bounds it.

include_issues.description: Analyze deprecated, outdated, duplicate and conflicting packages. Default false; scans the full graph unless max_depth bounds it. JSON includes complete issue rows.

lifecycle.description: Omit for runtime only. runtime, development, build, peer, optional (each adds that group to runtime), or all; one value, a comma list, or an array. all stands alone; case-insensitive.

max_depth.description: Add a `transitive` block and cap traversal at this depth (1-10). Omit for direct output unless `include_importers` is true; `include_issues` can still analyze the full graph.

target.description: Package registry:name[@version], for example npm:express@5.2.1; omit the version for latest. Go accepts versions with or without v; other registries reject v-prefixed git tags except Swift.

name: pkg_deps
